name: harsha-claude-marketplace
description: Personal Claude Code plugin marketplace by harshavardhanmadhamanchi

plugins.name: linkedin-job-hunt
plugins.description: Multi-agent LinkedIn job hunt with LaTeX resume tailoring. Searches target companies, scores fit asymmetrically against your resume, generates tailored per-job PDFs via tectonic, and saves approved jobs to LinkedIn.

plugins.name: resume-tailor
plugins.description: Standalone LaTeX resume tailoring with ATS scoring. Tailors base.tex against any job description, fetches portfolio website for supplemental context, iterates up to 5 times without degrading the ATS score, and writes actionable suggestions for manual improvements.

plugins.name: job-search
plugins.description: Web-only job search skill. Reads any resume (PDF/DOCX), asks a few preference questions, fans out parallel discovery workers across company buckets, verifies comp/links/routes per company, and renders two ranked tables: Apply Directly vs Get a Referral First. No LinkedIn auth or workspace required.
